IDENTITY. Requested claude-opus-4-8 HIGH; both 4.8 and 5.5 were user-authorized. My actual model is claude-opus-4-8 (Opus 4.8); the HIGH effort is harness-configured and not self-verified. This is a fresh, non-author, source-only SEAT B review of the F1 revised whole test candidate (test sha f6514a47...). Same provider (Anthropic) as the prefix/R00/part authors; NO provider or model diversity is claimed. One attempt, read-only tools only. Nothing was executed, imported, compiled, AST-parsed, hashed, linted or subprocessed. No R4 implementation exists, was supplied or inspected. nativeAuthority 0; this review is not an adoption/reliance vote.

SCOPE AND METHOD. I read the whole 1192-line test, R4-CONTRACT.md (CB401-CB412 and the section-7 R00-R17 obligation table), R4-API.json, R4-MANIFEST-F1-CONTRACT.json, the three dependency bodies (build_k10_inputs.py, host_codec.py, c2_issue_artifacts_r2.py) in full, ROOT-CP08-SOURCE-ADOPTION.json, ROOT-MEANINGFULNESS-ACCEPTANCE.json, ROOT-PUBLIC-FIXTURE-PINS.json, ROOT-LITERAL-ASSEMBLY.json, PROPOSED-RED-ENVELOPE.json, F1-AUTHOR-REVIEW.json, ROOT-OLD-RED-ACCEPTANCE.json and DOWNSTREAM-R4-CONDITIONAL-ADOPTION.json. I independently derived every expectation below from source, not from author claims. The B9 opaque body, the SOL files, the CP r2 contract/API, R4-TEST-INTERFACE.json, R4-PREFIX-NOTES.md, USER-BOTH-OPUS-RULE.md, the three per-part CONTRACT/NOTES JSONs and R4-MANIFEST-F1-NOTES.md were not opened (see coverage); the decisive facts were all verifiable from the files I read, and the CP dependency literals were verified against the actual r2 source rather than its contract.

ORDINARY RED (independently derived, not observed). load_r4 (lines 244-258) checks os.path.lexists(HERE/'build_k10_inputs_r4.py') and, when absent, calls case.fail('missing implementation: build_k10_inputs_r4.py') BEFORE setting _R4_LOAD_STARTED or touching importlib; TestCase.fail raises AssertionError. Every one of R01-R17 begins with self.r4()/r4=self.r4() (lines 569,603,619,674,708,727,771,813,869,883,915,954,981,1066,1094,1119,1154), so at RED their sole outcome is that AssertionError and no later assertion, wrapper, filesystem effect, mkfifo, umask toggle, 0555-parent WRITE or counter runs. TestR00Prerequisites.test_r00_prerequisites never references R4 and is substantive and R4-independent (it checks the 7 envelope PINS incl. the adopted r2 pin == ADOPTED_R2_PIN at line 497, module __file__ samefile, v1 absence, scratch 700/empty, open-flag/dir_fd capability, r2 on K6 returning /2 + 12 keys + exactly the 16 ordered labels, HIST-09 == the independent formatter == the legacy render, and the B9 policy recomputation). Predicted result therefore matches R4-CONTRACT.md section 8 and R4-API.json 'red': 18 methods, 1 pass (R00), 17 AssertionError failures all carrying the identical MISSING message, 0 errors, exit 1, empty stdout, scratch unchanged 0700/empty, isolated/ and its files byte/mode/listing unchanged. Any import/pin/malformed-fixture/setUpModule/R00 failure or any unittest error is STOP, not RED, with no retry.

STUB MEANINGFULNESS (source prediction). A CB401-conformant stub (the 9 imports hashlib/json/os/re/stat/sys/build_k10_inputs as legacy/c2_issue_artifacts_r2/host_codec, exactly one APPEND-SEAM line, and the 7 public functions parse_expiry/read_public_file/parse_public_json/check_setup_link/legacy_env_from_host/plan_outputs/main each raising NotImplementedError) PASSES R00 and R01 only: R01 is purely structural (AST import set, seam count 1, 7 non-underscore FunctionDefs, callability, no sys.modules/path attr, no c2_issue_artifacts/importlib binding) and a NotImplementedError body is still callable. Every one of R02-R17 reaches a stubbed function (plan_outputs via self.plan, parse_expiry, read_public_file, parse_public_json, check_setup_link, legacy_env_from_host, or main via run_main) which raises NotImplementedError before any assertion can pass, so each ERRORS rather than passing. The stub thus passes NONE of R02-R17, satisfying the review-time meaningfulness predicate and R4-CONTRACT.md section 8.

F1 CHANGES. Only R03 (Part A) and R13 (Part B) bodies plus attribution comments changed; R00, R01, R02, R04-R12 and all of Part C (R14-R17) are byte-identical, 18 method names/count/classes and the first-self.r4() in every method are preserved, no imports/helpers/wrappers/globals added. R13 now assembles an independent 33-key expected manifest with five R4-independent anchors (legacy constants; VK 488/proof 192 lengths; blake2b-256(K2 VK)==K6 vkDigest; host statement digest of the K6 statement; inline issue-CBOR == host encode of build_c2_mint_data('Issue',vk,proof)), then asserts set(expected)==MANIFEST_KEYS, a per-field subTest equality over all 33 keys, exact int types, every flag is identity-False, and outputs['manifest.json']==canonical_json(expected). I verified these anchors against build_k10_inputs.py (lines 61-87, 308-319, 397-430), host_codec.py (lines 536-656) and the inline CBOR math: the test's env_cbor and the host build_env_data+encode_data produce identical bytes, and the inline issue CBOR equals host_codec.encode_data(build_c2_mint_data('Issue',vk,proof)). This genuinely closes ROOT-OLD-RED-ACCEPTANCE RR-F01 (the 15 presence-only values). R03 edits the K6 statement at the host offsets claimantVkh[144:172], consumedTxid[233:265], consumedIx[265:267], recomputes the digest/public-inputs/cardano via the pinned host (independent of R4), and I confirmed the edited export is still admitted by r2 at every stage (SETUP..BUILD) so the GREEN assertions are reachable and not over-constrained; its stale-literal negative proof (K6 claimant 0x55*28, txid 0x22*32, expiry 1893456000000, K6 token, K6 statement digest absent from all non-script output) is a real explicit-invalidity proof, not a synthetic one.

GOVERNANCE/R00 OBLIGATION. The six GOVERNANCE_PINS (lines 49-56) literals exactly match the packet MANIFEST and CP08 pins (R4-CONTRACT.md b0aa395e, R4-API.json 2cfefb33, CP contract 6e2c3989, CP API 0f592eea, DOWNSTREAM cc729d8d, CP08 c322b2c2). These documents are deliberately NOT in the runtime envelope (isolated/ holds only the 8 staged files), so R00 structurally cannot and does not read them; it is disclosed (prefix lines 47-48) that root checks them as out-of-envelope pre/post assembly prerequisites. I DECIDE that R00's in-envelope obligation (adopted r2 bytes+pin+behaviour, fixture pins, v1 absence, scratch, HIST-09 cross-check) is fully and correctly discharged by test_r00_prerequisites, and that the governance-document portion of the contract's R00 text is acceptably delegated to root's mechanical six-pin pre/post verification which the proposed envelope beforeAfter requires. This is recorded as a condition, not silently waived: if root does not actually verify those six pins before/after launch, the R00 obligation is only partially met.

EFFECTS/ISOLATION (proposal only; actual effects not observed). The PROPOSED-RED-ENVELOPE argv is internally consistent and matches the contract: timeout 20s (TERM, kill-after 2s), prlimit cpu 10:10 / as 536870912 / fsize 2097152 / core 0, bwrap --unshare-all --die-with-parent --new-session, ro-bind /usr with usr symlinks, proc, dev, --dir /case, ro-bind isolated->/case/isolated (0555, files 0444), bind scratch->/case/scratch (0700 empty), chdir /case/isolated, clearenv + PATH/LANG/PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE only, python3 (realpath python3.14, sha 52e0a13e) -I -B. HERE resolves to /case/isolated and SCRATCH to /case/scratch, matching the binds; all test writes go only under scratch via case_scratch()/copy_inputs. stdout/stderr are to be exclusive regular files outside the child sandbox bounded by inherited RLIMIT_FSIZE (not pipes) — correct, since RLIMIT_FSIZE bounds regular files but not pipes. rlimits alone are not network isolation; bwrap --unshare-all is the proposed isolation and its actual effect is unobserved. This envelope is NOT execution permission: testExecutionApproved false, rootDecisionPending true, maximumAttempts 1, prerequisite failure is STOP with no retry. Host launch is root-only AFTER two fresh substantive agreeing audits and a root decision; this is one such audit.

ADOPTION/NON-CLAIMS/ROUTING. CP08 adopts the exact r2 bytes for ordinary artifact preparation and R4 TEST AUTHORING ONLY; implementationAdopted true but builderReliancePermitted false, R4ImplementationPermitted/Execution false, nativeAuthority 0. r2 (not v1) is imported; v1 c2_issue_artifacts is prohibited, absent from the envelope, and asserted absent at R00 (lines 506-508) and R01 (line 600); no /2-to-/1 or CB-r1 routing; the old superseded profile is not relabeled. The old ordinary RED (test sha c9375097) is explicitly bound to the old bytes and does NOT transfer; a fresh RED decision for these bytes is required. All open tracks remain OPEN (20 UTxO families, full finance, ACTUS, DeFi, PCD recursion, private handoff, bounded multiparent, real Preprod; no Groth16/curve/VK-profile/Rust-acceptance/ledger inference).

DISPOSITION. The source is complete, self-consistent, literally assembled from the recorded parts, closes RR-F01 with R4-independent oracles verified against the actual dependency source, preserves the meaningful RED shape unchanged, and introduces no reachable or future-GREEN test-side bug I could find. The remaining items (OD1 four API-unrestated fields, OD2 varied-export inputs[] omission, hardcoded-genuine indistinguishability for vk/proof/issue/proofSha, anchors-derived-by-reading, stale historical docstring text, same-provider non-diversity, and the governance-pin delegation condition) are disclosed and non-blocking for source readiness and for one ordinary RED, but each is a GREEN/owner obligation that must not be waived on the strength of a passing RED. I find sourceReady true (bounded strictly to the ordinary R4 test-authoring basis and one ordinary RED consideration) and ordinaryRedReady true; implementationReady and builderReliancePermitted are false and remain so.
